❌ Legacy SIP Content-Indirection Failure Modes (RFC 4483 / 5547)
1. Blind message/external-body URL SSRF: Untrusted INVITE points
access-type="URL" to http://169.254.169.254/..., leaking cloud credentials.
2. Indirect application/sdp Signaling Stall: Wrapping SDP in external-body
forces synchronous HTTP fetches on the SIP call-setup thread (Slowloris DoS).
3. Indirect Payload Amplification OOM Bomb: A 200-byte SIP pointer expands
into a 500 MB chunked HTTP response, exhausting B2BUA memory pools.
Result: Zero-click IMDS SSRF + SIP worker thread starvation & OOM
✅ Deterministic P1005–P1006 🎉 (SVG 150 & 1,015 Guards!) Gate
1. P1005 (1,014th Guard) Inline-SDP Mandate & [1,4] mTLS Host Allowlist:
Forbid indirect application/sdp (SIP 415) & cap trusted hosts in [1, 4].
2. P1006 🎉 (🎉 Historic SVG 150 & 1,015th Guard) [4, 64] KB Stream Cap:
Clamp indirect HTTP stream reads in [4, 64] KB with <=300ms async timeout.
3. Voice-First Non-Blocking Fallback: Drop oversized or timed-out
context attachments while completing inline SDP voice call setup in 0ms.
Result: 0 external-body SSRF · 0 amplification stalls · cap ∈ [4, 64] KB
